implementation.targetScope: Keymap 1.2.3 binding aliases, modifier precedence, platform Mod/AltGraph behavior and Plugin integration with current/app Tiptap keyboard controls. Browser view and full app adoption remain separate.

changes: Independent compiled key/modifier tables avoid modifier-string assembly per keyboard event.
Only own enumerable binding properties are registered; inherited definitions are ignored.
Runtime dependencies are vw3c-keyname 2.2.8 and vprosemirror-state 1.4.4. No upstream runtime source shipped.
Matches the published 1.2.3 Shift-only behavior; one stale upstream source assertion fails both controls and is explicitly checked/documented.
